environment: Local PHP contract doubles; actual QIL_Personalization and exact-repeat/inventory implementation

tests.name: Context IDs and filters are bounded and normalized
Malformed identifiers do not become products
Guest cannot read prior purchases
Own-order repeat does not require optional profiling
Only the current account is queried
Client cannot select a different user
Pending and cancelled orders excluded
Synthetic issuer orders excluded
Full quantity refund excluded
Full monetary refund excluded
Partial refund preserves remaining purchase
Warm history revalidates owner and status
Warm reference never caches old prices
Warm reference never bypasses live stock
Exact old variation keeps its own current price
Unavailable old option is never replaced by sibling
Changed old variation attributes cannot silently substitute
Missing saved choice is not inferred
Disabled old option cannot be bought again
Insufficient quantity or backorder is not advertised as available
Hidden, draft, passworded, missing image, zero-priced items excluded
Eligibility veto is honored
Current product, related products, cart, and removed items excluded
A parent occurs once across all tabs
Impressions do not fabricate Recently Viewed
Recent actual views require current permission
Newer actual views precede older ones
Future and over-30-day activity ignored
New variation view retains its parent timestamp after older purchase
Purchase after a view does not remain unfinished browsing
Optional owner outage does not break own-order service
Guest contextual selection uses current category without history
Cart keeps four relevant cross-sells and no competitors
Related rollout zero preserves Buy Again
Combined dietary filters are AND, unknown excluded
An explicit conflicting old option overrides parent dietary claim
Value per serving uses the exact old variant price and count
Value ranking considers cheap seventh hydrated choice before tab cutoff
Value Buy Again ranks cheap seventh verified item before tab cutoff
Value excludes missing servings
History cache is invalidated by native order updates
Per-account reference contention skips waiting
Public pool cache contains IDs only and skips repeat query
Read bounds remain 48 candidates, 20 full records, six per tab
Cross-account history argument rejected before query
Signed presentation is bound to account and session
Revocation invalidates signed presentation
Tampered presentation is rejected
Cross-origin read is rejected
New Arrival still includes 20-day first publication
Expired new arrival and unobserved restock stay false
Back-in-stock timestamp remains exact to a variation
